title: Radio: White Van at Lodge Parking Pad — Birch Hollow Range

lines.text: Ops, this is Site Manager at Birch Hollow Range. A white van with a rooftop antenna and a 915 MHz transceiver left the lodge parking pad (TP-LFA-LP1) at 09:10. No ID on the vehicle. It was not on the site survey form. The lodge Wi-Fi is on 10.17.40.11.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slight background wind and distant engine hum

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. Security must verify the van's absence from the visitor log and initiate site lockdown.
